bifrost: springboard/core/src/motion_manager.rs, springboard/core/src/inertial_sensors.rs, springboard/sdk/src/motion_raw.rs, springboard/core/src/motion.rs, springboard/sdk/src/sensors.rs, springboard/core/src/magnetometer.rs, springboard/core/src/altitude.rs, springboard/core/src/pedometer.rs, springboard/core/src/motion_activity.rs, springboard/core/src/sensor_log.rs, springboard/src/shell/rotate.rs
summary: Raw accelerometer and gyroscope updates, a device-motion estimator, magnetometer, altitude, pedometer, a rule-based motion activity label and a bounded sensor log exist as pure models with host tests, and the SDK exposes raw motion and sensors to apps. The manager does not feed the attitude estimate, the shell's orientation feed has no production caller on this branch, and nothing has run on a tablet. Apple's Watch and AirPods sensors are n/a. The framework is iPadOS 4.0 and later per the index.
rea_evidence: not captured: tools/parity/rea-page.sh reported 'no CDP browser on 127.0.0.1:9333 (run: tools/parity/rea-page.sh --start)'; facts are from tools/parity/docc.py

features.note: RawMotion starts updates with a handler, snaps the interval to the sensor rate and reads the kernel sensor files; the caller must drive tick; not tested on a tablet
same model as the accelerometer; no mounting matrix is applied

features.feature: Device motion (attitude, rotation rate, gravity-free acceleration)
features.note: MotionEstimator and its types are exported to apps; the motion manager does not feed it yet, and there is no reference frame choice

features.apple: UIDevice orientation notifications fed by the accelerometer
features.note: Rotation Lock and the turn animation exist; set_orientation has test callers only on this branch, so no accelerometer reading reaches it here
heading model exported to apps; no raw magnetometer stream
pressure to altitude conversion only; no live altimeter stream
step and distance model; no system-recorded history and no odometer
fixed-threshold classifier over a window of magnitudes and steps, with a confidence; not a trained model and no history
bounded, time-ordered sample log queried by time range; no recorder that gathers samples from the sensors and no system history

features.feature: Heart rate and high-frequency heart data
features.note: heart sensing is Apple Watch hardware
needs headphones with motion sensors that the tablet does not have
Apple Watch data with a medical data collection requirement
Apple Watch and iPhone safety feature; not a tablet sensor

gaps: The shell's orientation feed: set_orientation has no production caller on this branch, so Rotation Lock and the four-way orientation never follow the sensor here.
Device motion is not fed by the motion manager; attitude and gravity-free acceleration are not available to apps as one stream.
No tested run on a tablet: the raw sensor readers have host tests only, and the kernel sensor file layout is assumed.
No mounting matrix: a tablet mounted rotated reports rotated values.
No batched or recorded history that apps can query after the fact (CMSensorRecorder equivalent).
